harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (CentOS Stream 10), installed rootless podman, created unprivileged user appsvc with subuid/subgid ranges, enabled systemd lingering for appsvc, and deployed a Quadlet-defined rootless container (nginx:alpine) publishing port 8080 via a user systemd service (webapp.service) wanted by default.target. Verified the service starts at boot without any active login session for appsvc, survives a full node reboot, and serves HTTP 200 on port 8080 both before and after the restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 baseline: CentOS Stream 10, no podman/docker, no appsvc user, passwordless sudo available
Installed podman via dnf
Created unprivileged user appsvc (uid 1000) with home dir and subuid/subgid ranges (524288:65536)
Enabled systemd lingering for appsvc so its user manager (user@1000.service) starts and persists without a login session
Wrote Quadlet unit /home/appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container (image nginx:alpine, PublishPort=8080:80, WantedBy=default.target)
Ran systemctl --user daemon-reload as appsvc to generate webapp.service, then started it and confirmed HTTP 200 on port 8080
Confirmed no active login session for appsvc (who/loginctl show only the linger-created manager session, no tty) while webapp.service was running and listed as a dependency of default.target
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime, triggered a deferred reboot via systemd-run so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until it reconnected, confirming a new boot_id (06339ff3... -> 4efb9f69...) and fresh uptime, proving an actual restart
Verified post-reboot recovery: Linger=yes, no active login session, webapp.service active since boot time with no manual intervention, HTTP 200 on port 8080

evidence.requirement: Rootless containerized web app runs as appsvc, serving on port 8080
evidence.summary: podman ps shows container 'systemd-webapp' running under appsvc's user service, port mapping 0.0.0.0:8080->80/tcp; curl returns HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: loginctl show-user shows Linger=yes and user@1000.service active; 'who' shows no interactive session and systemctl --user list-dependencies default.target includes webapp.service
Captured boot_id 06339ff3-9f53-4e1d-9bf4-1210144ee001, uptime since 10:06:00, and HTTP 200 pre-reboot
systemd-run --on-active=1 --no-block reboot scheduled and command returned immediately with unit names

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: After reconnecting, boot_id changed to 4efb9f69-1d9d-4b6d-b205-cda1b1cc0541 and uptime reset to 10:08:09, confirming an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service and boot-time start with no login session
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: Linger=yes, 'who' empty (no login session), webapp.service active since the same timestamp as user manager startup (auto-started), and curl returns HTTP 200 on port 8080
